description: Oscillator with square, saw, triangle and sine running at once, each on its own output

params.text: Sets the pitch, marked in volts; 0V gives C4 at 261.63Hz
Trims the pitch up to a semitone either way
Drops the whole pitch range by seven octaves, so the module runs as an LFO
Sets the pulse width of the square wave, with a 50% square at noon
Sets how deeply the FM jack modulates the frequency
The switch beside the FM knob picks exponential modulation or linear through-zero modulation
Frequency follows the pitch voltage at 1000Hz per volt rather than an octave per volt, and the oscillator stops at 0V

inputs.text: Pitch at a volt per octave, added to the frequency knob; the channels patched here set the oscillator's polyphony
A rising edge here hard-syncs the oscillator, restarting its cycle
Modulates the width of the square wave
Sets how deeply the FM jack modulates the frequency

outputs.text: Square, saw, triangle and sine, all from the same oscillator at the same pitch

menu: Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, V/OCT input or FM input
DC offset correction — on by default, removes the offset the square and pulse waves carry away from a 50% width; turn it off to use such an output as a CV
